2228-4279-5708.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-5708.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-5708.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

789-4279-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
789-4279-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Gutter Grime and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Gutter Grime ability, creating a X/X Ooze creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

813-5531-5694-6664-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
813-5531-5694-6664-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Scholar of the Ages and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Scholar of the Ages and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Repeat.
813-5531-5694-6664-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Scholar of the Ages and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

2105-6591-8095--85.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-6591-8095--85.description:
Declare Squall and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Combat Celebrant.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Combat Celebrant from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1981-2415-6097-6798.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6097-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-7315-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Shang-Chi and High Score.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2334-3258-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using Soulherder. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
2334-3258-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

851-1558-3478-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
851-1558-3478-3875-4231.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2511-4871-5220-5651.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2511-4871-5220-5651.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2757-3713-5078-6918.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Steelfin Whale, untapping a basic land.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Steelfin Whale triggers, untapping Steelfin Whale.
Repeat.

3490-3755-5295-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-3755-5295-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

3921-4772-6575--85.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield with four lore counters on it due to Doubling Season and Winding Constrictor, its fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-2173-4336-5220.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

5220-5256-6538-6900.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Fear of Lost Teeth.
When Fear of Lost Teeth dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Fear of Lost Teeth from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Fear of Lost Teeth trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to any target
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Cast Fear of Lost Teeth from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

2034-3490-5572-6783.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
2034-3490-5572-6783.description:
Activate Junk Golem by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Dragon Appeasement triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2457-4289-4359-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

465-3742-4251-5929-6633.notablePrerequisites: Leyline of Transformation on the battlefield with "Samurai" chosen.
465-3742-4251-5929-6633.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

2440-2703-6633.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

1069-2457-5499-6633.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-2457-5499-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Insect.
Activate the Insect by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may repeat step 1 as desired.

1913-2073-5226--90.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact with mana value 1 or less.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Salvaging Station triggers twice, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

372-813-961.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-813-961.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Scholar of the Ages and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Scholar of the Ages trigger.
Resolve the Scholar of the Ages trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Scholar of the Ages and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2730-2892-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Trusty Retriever, adding {B}.
When Trusty Retriever dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Trusty Retriever from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Trusty Retriever enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Kaya's Ghostform by paying {B}, attaching it to Trusty Retriever.
Repeat.

745-1636-2857.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
745-1636-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Mirrorhall Mimic by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Mirrorhall Mimic.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Mirrorhall Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Mirrorhall Mimic to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

2115-2615-2773.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Offspring's Revenge triggers, exiling Tree of Perdition from your graveyard and creating a 1/1 copy of it with haste.
When the Tree of Perdition token enters the battlefield, Warstorm Surge triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Tree of Perdition token by tapping it, swapping an opponent's life total with Tree of Perdition's toughness.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, causing the Tree of Perdition token to deal damage equal to its power to the opponent whose life total was swapped.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or les life.

132-198-4222.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

575-1794-2641.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one additional black card in hand.
575-1794-2641.description:
Activate Ruthless Ripper's morph ability by revealing a black card from your hand, turning it face-up and triggering its ability.
Ruthless Ripper dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning Ruthless Ripper to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Ruthless Ripper trigger from step 1, causing target player to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

1199-3830-4871-5066.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1199-3830-4871-5066.description:
Cast Fallen Ideal by paying {B}, targeting any other creature you control.
Monastery Mentor's prowess and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first Monastery Mentor trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the second Monastery Mentor trigger, creating a 1/1 Monk creature token.
Activate the creature that Fallen Ideal is attached to by sacrificing it.
The creature dies, triggering Fallen Ideal and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the Fallen Ideal trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the ability from step 3, doing nothing since the creature is no longer on the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.

2732-2781-4050.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, triggering its ability, targeting Prowling Geistcatcher.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, adding one mana of any color.
Prowling Geistcatcher triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian from your graveyard.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger from 2, blinking Prowling Geistcatcher.
Prowling Geistcatcher leaves the battlefield, returning Felidar Guardian from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

757-4235-4407.notablePrerequisites: Unbender Tine does not have summoning sickness.
757-4235-4407.description:
Activate Magosi's second activated ability by tapping it and paying {U}.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Resolve the Magosi ability, putting an eon counter on Magosi and skipping your next turn.
Activate Unbender Tine by tapping it targeting Magosi.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; choose not to pay for it.
Activate Magosi's third activated ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it, and returning it to your hand.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers; pay {2} and copy the Magosi ability.
Resolve both copies of the ability, cancelling out your skipped turn and taking an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

2882-3696-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-3696-4675-4694.description:
Cast Bone Saw by paying {0}.
Bone Saw enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Bone Saw from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
